nodes.title: JWT & identity dependencies
nodes.description: HS256 token creation/verification with expiration. HTTPBearer resolves the sub claim to a database User; required and optional dependencies are separate.

nodes.title: Catalog API
nodes.description: Lists genres, paginates and filters movies, performs title/genre search, and resolves movie details. Missing artwork may trigger TMDB enrichment.

nodes.title: Recommendation & metrics API
nodes.description: Serves personalized, cold-start, similar, most-rated, popular and genre lists plus taste-state and offline metric reports. Numeric user targets resolve only to the requester.
nodes.note: The metrics endpoint reads an offline artifact; it does not measure live accuracy.

nodes.title: Activity API
nodes.description: Records play/like/list events, maintains watch history, current likes/watchlist and refreshes genre signals. User identity comes from the bearer dependency.

nodes.title: Live preference signals
nodes.description: Rebuilds genre weights from current onboarding genres, plays and current likes, replacing UserGenrePreference rows. This is request-time profile updating, not model training.

nodes.title: Assistant API
nodes.description: Authenticated chat, session, filter and feedback endpoints enforce ownership. Chat requests pass per-user and per-IP in-memory rate limits before orchestration.

nodes.title: Conversation orchestration
nodes.description: Persists messages and intent deltas, excludes seen/watched titles and enforces hard constraints. Catalog lookup returns title matches; discovery branches rank candidates and produce evidence-backed explanations.

nodes.title: Metadata / keyword retrieval
nodes.description: Searches SQL movie titles/descriptions and structured genre, year, runtime and rating filters. Reference titles can seed item similarity. No vector retrieval call exists in this service.
nodes.note: Despite the filename semantic_search.py, this implementation does not perform embedding similarity.

nodes.title: Intent & explanation adapter
nodes.description: Local-only mode defaults to deterministic intent parsing and catalogue-evidence explanations. Explicitly disabling local mode permits google-genai calls; missing keys, exceptions or unusable responses fall back to heuristics/templates.
nodes.note: Cloud calls are disabled by default. Provider credentials, configured model availability, quota and live responses were not checked.

nodes.title: Optional recommendation review
nodes.description: The signed-in homepage offers an opt-in review of a frozen recommendation slate. Interesting/not-for-me/unsure answers are saved separately from plays and likes.
nodes.note: UI verification is not human participation or evidence of satisfaction.

nodes.title: Owned recommendation study API
nodes.description: Requires consent and bearer identity to create a frozen slate and policy snapshot. Owned read/update endpoints save per-movie answers without changing recommendation history.

nodes.title: Reversible exclusions & positive history
nodes.description: Last not-interested/show-again decision controls exclusions. Positive history deduplicates movies, excludes hidden titles and ignores removed likes. A play is activity rather than proof of enjoyment.

nodes.description: ranking_policy selects history bins, candidate positions and normalized fusion. DAMR separately computes drift/focus/maturity/freshness, adaptive expert weights, momentum, quality and diversity.

nodes.title: Model loader & inference
nodes.description: Singleton ModelService resolves active_bundle.json, loads maps/matrices and three checkpoint architectures, switches to eval mode and validates serving-policy checkpoint hashes.

nodes.title: Artwork enrichment adapter
nodes.description: Uses MovieLens/TMDB ID links or title/year searches to fetch metadata with urllib, stores missing artwork/synopsis/runtime in movies and returns CDN URLs.
nodes.note: Enabled only with a TMDB key and missing poster data; provider calls were not checked.

nodes.title: SQLAlchemy session & schema
nodes.description: Configured PostgreSQL engine with pool health checks. get_db opens/closes request sessions; declarative ORM maps 13 tables. Tests may use SQLite independently.

nodes.title: Recommendation study records
nodes.description: recommendation_studies stores an owned frozen movie slate, serving policy snapshot and replaceable per-movie judgments. No participant results are invented.

nodes.title: Users & preference tables
nodes.description: users, user_preferences and user_genre_preferences store account identities, optional MovieLens identity mapping, onboarding selections and live genre weights.

nodes.title: Movie catalog table
nodes.description: movies stores canonical MovieLens movie_id, title, genres, rating/count, runtime, description and poster/backdrop URLs.

nodes.title: Activity tables
nodes.description: interactions, watch_history, my_list and likes relate users to movies. Current likes/watchlist uniqueness and interaction history are distinct state.

nodes.title: Assistant persistence
nodes.description: assistant_sessions stores user-owned accumulated intent; assistant_messages stores transcript and returned IDs; assistant_feedback records feedback. Message/movie feedback IDs are not declared foreign keys.

nodes.title: Embedding metadata (unused)
nodes.description: movie_text_embeddings declares model/dimension/hash metadata and a movie foreign key. No embedding vector column or active reader/writer is found in app services.

nodes.description: Metadata/search provider and image.tmdb.org CDN URL source. Browsers render returned artwork URLs directly; API keys stay in backend configuration.

nodes.title: MovieLens / catalog files
nodes.description: Local catalog/link JSON is consumed by seed/enrichment scripts. Training data preparation can read MovieLens ratings/movies CSV or stored histories and produces mappings/sequences/matrices.
nodes.note: Data contents and licensing provenance were not independently audited; only readers and local file locations are mapped.

nodes.title: Offline training & evaluation
nodes.description: Fresh training splits sequences into training/validation/test, writes checkpoints/config/logs and sampled/full-catalog metrics. Evaluation scripts select policies and produce research evidence.
nodes.note: Only source/metadata inspection was done here; training/evaluation was not rerun. This explorer does not modify weights.

nodes.note: Pointer/config files exist. Checkpoint bytes were not loaded or revalidated by the explorer scanner.

walkthroughs.title: Sign in & restore
walkthroughs.summary: Credentials → bcrypt → signed token → bearer identity → restored session.
steps: Enter credentials or restore a saved session. The frontend guard is only a UI guard.
Auth API wrappers POST JSON; later requests attach the saved Bearer token.
Login reads the account and verifies its password before returning accessToken and user.
Passlib checks bcrypt. python-jose signs/verifies exp and sub using backend configuration.
Protected dependencies resolve sub to a current users row; /me restores the profile.

walkthroughs.title: Movie recommendations
walkthroughs.summary: Home feed → user-aware policy → frozen model inference → hydrated movie results.
steps: Home queries recommendations keyed by the current user; guests receive a fallback feed.
Only the requester can resolve a numeric target. The handler dispatches to the engine.
Mapped identities use model scores. New accounts branch to sequence/neighbor or cold-start logic.
Inference uses loaded PyTorch models and genre matrices from the selected bundle, without retraining.
Auto uses normalized_fixed for the mapped bundle; new-user history bins choose a frozen policy. DAMR is a separate supported branch.
The engine hydrates scored IDs into movie schemas for the response and UI rails.

walkthroughs.title: Ask Filmory
walkthroughs.summary: Chat → intent delta → strict catalog filters → lookup or ranking → evidence/explanation.
steps: Send a message with the selected session ID; the route guards stale responses.
Bearer identity, ownership checks and in-memory rate limits precede the chat handler.
Create/load a session, persist the user message and merge explicit intent changes.
Parse locally by default. Cloud intent/explanation calls require disabling local-only mode; external success is unverified.
Apply title/keyword and metadata constraints plus watched/session exclusions in SQL.
Title lookup bypasses reranking. Discovery may score candidates with the configured DAMR branch.
Store transcript and returned IDs, and return grounded evidence plus an explanation/template.

walkthroughs.title: Feedback & taste updates
walkthroughs.summary: Like/play/save → authenticated persistence → live genre signals → query invalidation.
steps: MovieActions delegates play, like and list actions to UserDataContext.
Action requests are guarded per user/action. Play is a simulated interaction, not a video stream.
The authenticated user controls whose history/likes/list rows are changed.
Persist event history and current activity state with user/movie foreign keys.
Refresh genre weights from onboarding genres, plays and current likes. No checkpoint training occurs.
Relevant query keys are invalidated; subsequent recommendation requests see the new profile.

walkthroughs.title: Optional classmate review
walkthroughs.summary: Explicit consent → frozen slate → owned judgments, separate from viewing history.
steps: Opt in from Home and review a frozen movie list; participation is optional.
Typed requests send consent when creating a review and movie/choice when answering.
Bearer ownership gates every operation. A movie must belong to the frozen slate.
Create the slate from the current policy before collecting any answers.
Store movie/policy snapshots and replaceable judgments without changing plays or likes.

walkthroughs.title: Offline artifacts → inference
walkthroughs.summary: Local histories/CSV → split & train → bundle files → explicit active pointer → loader.
steps: Data preparation reads local MovieLens-format inputs or stored ordinal histories.
Fresh training holds out validation/test targets and writes checkpoints and genuine metric logs into args.output.
The checked-in pointer selects a specific bundle; serving-policy hashes bind overlays to checkpoint bytes. Activation is separate.
ModelService reads the pointer and config, loads matrices/maps/models and verifies policy hashes.
/api/metrics reads selected offline metrics; these are not live user satisfaction or overall accuracy.

limitations: Arrows are direct source calls, composition, router registration, artifact access or declared foreign keys. They do not certify that the live branch executed.
No application startup, database query, provider request, training, migration or checkpoint deserialization was performed by the scanner.
Python is parsed with AST. TypeScript routes/imports use bounded regex extraction; dynamic imports, build-time plugin internals and runtime-generated paths may be incomplete.

The graph aggregates modules and tables for readability; the inventory lists all scanned application, script, migration, test, style and CI source files. Third-party internals, binaries, raw data, secrets and generated builds are excluded.
Embedding metadata and settings exist, but active vector search and pgvector use are not demonstrated by this application source.
Gemini/TMDB credentials, provider model availability, live database schema and optional preview hook destinations remain unverified.
Research claims, model quality, source data provenance, streaming support and deployed service availability cannot be certified by an architecture diagram.
